title: Full chat transcript recovery and ingestion — executable extension

source_provenance.notes: 5/5 runtime verification + exact Git blob identity

problem_or_opportunity: Large prior-chat results can be lost or misremembered; deterministic extraction must be separated from persisted-claim verification, canon disposition and ingestion completion.
proposed_mechanism: INGEST -> PARSE -> RECOVER_PROJECT_FRONTIER -> VERIFY_PERSISTED_CLAIMS -> RECOVER_CHAT_ONLY_CANDIDATES -> DEDUPE -> RECONCILE -> PERSIST -> LEARN -> READBACK -> CONTINUE, with fail-closed completeness and no invented missing details.
expected_benefit: Recovers material sibling-dialog work without treating chat memory as authority and prevents false saved/locked/pass claims.
red_team_findings: Deterministic extraction cannot certify persisted claims or canon
INGESTION_COMPLETE forbidden until all material items are dispositioned and accepted writes read back
next_action: Operate on first real large transcript; then package verified extension into next full engine release with fresh-unzip regression.
notes: N05 write-through record. Base CURRENT_IMPROVEMENT_REGISTRY.json must either absorb this record or the registry contract must explicitly route extensions; N06 invariant test prevents silent drift.
